//: Deterministic rule set (Section 8.3.1). Each rule maps a profile constraint to conflicting concepts and the classification to apply given the ingredient source. Data-driven and testable without the LLM.
//_semantics: if = '<kind>:<value>' matches the user's profile. conceptMatches = normalized concepts (from aliasMap) that conflict. whenSource = which ingredient sources trigger this rule. result = classification to apply. The priority resolver picks the most severe fired result.

rules.reasonTemplate: Contains {concept}, which conflicts with your {constraint} allergy.
May contain {concept}, which conflicts with your {constraint} allergy.
rules.questionTemplate: Does the {dish} contain {concept} or is it prepared near it?

rules.reasonTemplate: Contains {concept}, which conflicts with a vegetarian restriction.
Contains {concept}, which conflicts with a vegan restriction.
Contains {concept}, which conflicts with a halal restriction.
rules.questionTemplate: Is the {dish} halal and free of {concept}?

rules.reasonTemplate: Contains {concept}, which conflicts with a gluten-free restriction.
May contain {concept}; confirm the {dish} is gluten-free.
rules.questionTemplate: Is the {dish} prepared gluten-free without shared surfaces?

rules.reasonTemplate: Contains {concept}, which conflicts with a lactose-free restriction.
rules.questionTemplate: Can the {dish} be prepared without dairy?

rules.reasonTemplate: May be high in sodium, which conflicts with a low-sodium preference.
rules.questionTemplate: Can the {dish} be prepared with less salt?

rules.reasonTemplate: May be high in sugar, which conflicts with a low-sugar preference.
rules.questionTemplate: Is the {dish} prepared with added sugar?

rules.reasonTemplate: May be spicy, which conflicts with a spicy-food avoidance preference.
